identity.name: PanoMaticLunar
identity.one_liner: The PanoMaticLunar with the asymmetric panodate dial layout and an in-house moon-phase — the most-cited Glashütte Original complication.

narrative.story: The PanoMaticLunar pairs the asymmetric "Pano" dial layout (off-centre hour/minute, large panorama date, moon-phase at 2 o'clock) with the in-house Calibre 90-02 — a Glashütte three-quarter-plate automatic with a 42-hour reserve. The moon-phase display is a hand-painted golden moon against a blue sky. The PanoMaticLunar is the most-cited Glashütte Original complication and the watch a collector cites when they want a moon-phase that is a German manufacture piece rather than a Swiss classic.
narrative.collector_notes: The asymmetric dial is a GO signature. The panorama date (large double-digit date window) is a Glashütte watchmaking tradition shared with Lange's outsize date.
